trello.name: Frontend checkout and pricing page implementation
trello.desc: Jordan to implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements, matching the app's design, handling errors gracefully, and updating the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers with clear feature comparisons and tooltips for plan changes.

trello.name: User dashboard implementation
trello.desc: Jordan to implement the user dashboard to show current plan details and billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel, access to invoices and payment history, and update payment methods, reflecting real-time status.

trello.name: Backend Stripe API and webhook integration
trello.desc: Taylor to integrate Stripe's API for creating/managing subscriptions and processing payments, and set up webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed (with email notifications), and customer.subscription.deleted events.

trello.name: Frontend and backend API integration
trello.desc: Jordan to integrate the frontend with the backend API, ensuring real-time dashboard updates and handling user notifications for events like subscription confirmations and payment errors.

trello.name: Test plan preparation
trello.desc: Taylor to prepare and share a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription.

trello.name: API and webhook documentation
trello.desc: Taylor to document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers for future maintenance and troubleshooting.

trello.name: User documentation and FAQ
trello.desc: Create a help section or FAQ with clear instructions for users on how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, and handle common issues.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting
trello.desc: Alex to set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress and address any issues.
